Because the ocean cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the prism audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 69 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 69 of them. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
